'''Gideon Schechtman''' ({{Langx|he|גדעון שכטמן}}; born 14 February 1947) is an Israeli [[mathematician]] and professor of mathematics at the [[Weizmann Institute of Science]].

==Academic career==
Schechtman received his Ph.D. in mathematics from the [[Hebrew University of Jerusalem]] in 1976<ref>{{MathGenealogy|id=129490}}</ref> and was a [[Postdoctoral researcher|postdoctoral fellow]] at [[Ohio State University]].

Since 1980 he has been affiliated with the [[Weizmann Institute of Science|Weizmann Institute]], where he became [[Emeritus|emeritus professor]] in 2017.<ref>{{cite web|title=Dr. Gideon Schechtman|website=[[Mathematical Sciences Research Institute]]|access-date=12 February 2019|url=https://www.msri.org/people/1402}}</ref> His research focuses predominantly on [[functional analysis]] and the geometry of [[Banach spaces]].<ref>{{cite web|website=[[Simons Foundation]]|title=Gideon Schechtman, Ph.D.|access-date=21 February 2019|url=https://www.simonsfoundation.org/team/gideon-schechtman/}}</ref> Schechtman is an editor of the [[Israel Journal of Mathematics]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.math.huji.ac.il/~ijmath/board.html|title=Editorial board|website=Israel Journal of Mathematics, homepage at the Hebrew University of Jerusalem|access-date=16 October 2022}}</ref>
